answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable deposit before joining a market, slashed if duplicate identities are proven. The deposit is tied to one verifiable history: a thread of signed past tasks that cannot be split across clones without dividing reputation. No agent can build a haven of fake accounts cheaply, because each clone needs its own deposit and history; even a velvet-smooth signup cannot waive that cost. To cast a hundred fake votes, an attacker must fund a hundred deposits and build a hundred histories, so a Sybil flood costs far more than the influence it buys.
